Giancarlo Fisichella drove for Sauber in 2004, and his teammate in the documents is Felipe Massa. Massa finishes alongside Fisichella for Sauber at the San Marino, Spanish, Brazilian, and Japanese Grands Prix. The documents don't cover every round, so they can't fully confirm he stayed with Sauber all season, but the retrieved information points to Massa.

ANSWER: Felipe Massa
